resources.string: Analyze a JavaCard or install the PKOC applet over NFC. Choose an action, then hold the card flat against the back of the phone and keep it still until finished.
Custom key (one key for ENC / MAC / DEK)
Use the GlobalPlatform card-manager key from the card supplier. This is not the PKOC credential key. Keys are not saved.
Deletes applet A000000898000001 and package A000000898000002 before installing. The card\'s existing PKOC key pair is destroyed permanently and its credential number will change.
The existing PKOC applet and package will be deleted and reinstalled. The current PKOC key pair cannot be recovered and the card\'s credential number will change.
Hold a card to the phone to scan it, or choose an action.
Analyze: hold the card to the phone…
Install: hold the card flat against the phone and keep it still…
NFC is turned off. Enable it in Settings.
